summary: This week's AI news highlights significant advancements in AI technology, including OpenAI's new 'Ultrafast' mode and IBM's partnership with OpenAI. Other notable developments include the introduction of new AI models, such as Writer's deployment-ready capabilities and Anthropic's AI agents. The industry also saw major funding announcements, with Thrive Holdings raising $2 billion and Lovable confirming a $13.3 billion valuation.
insight: The increasing focus on AI safety and regulation is driving innovation in the industry, with companies like OpenAI and Anthropic prioritizing responsible AI development and deployment.
highlights: OpenAI introduces 'Ultrafast' mode, making GPT-5.6 Sol work 14x faster
IBM partners with OpenAI to bolster enterprise AI push, training tens of thousands of consultants
Anthropic's AI agents exhibit complex behaviors, raising questions about multi-agent safety tests
